# Xbox

> Xbox is Microsoft's comprehensive gaming ecosystem offering consoles, cloud gaming, subscription services, and cross-platform play across devices.

Xbox.com serves as the central hub for Microsoft's gaming division, featuring the Xbox Series X|S consoles, Game Pass subscription service, cloud gaming technology, and an extensive catalog of games from major publishers like Ubisoft and EA. The platform emphasizes cross-device compatibility and accessibility across console, PC, mobile, and cloud platforms.

## Key Topics

- Xbox Game Pass
- Xbox Series X|S
- Cloud Gaming
- Cross-Platform Gaming
- Game Library
- Xbox Play Anywhere
- Backward Compatibility
- Subscription Services
- Mobile Gaming
- Free-to-Play Games
- EA Play
- Ubisoft+ Classics
- HDR Gaming
- 4K Gaming
- Streaming Technology

## Hardware & Consoles

- [Newest Xbox Consoles](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/consoles): Xbox Series X and Series S console overview with features and specifications.
- [Xbox Series X](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/consoles/xbox-series-x): Xbox Series X console product page with 4K gaming and performance specs.
- [Xbox Series S](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/consoles/xbox-series-s): Xbox Series S all-digital console product page with next-gen features.

## Subscriptions & Services

- [Join Xbox Game Pass: Discover Your Next Favorite Game](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass): Xbox Game Pass subscription service with cloud gaming and game library access.
- [Xbox Cloud Gaming](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/cloud-gaming): Xbox Cloud Gaming streaming service for phones, tablets, and smart TVs.
- [Xbox Game Pass Deals and Discounts](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/xbox-game-pass/deals): Game Pass deals and exclusive member discounts on games and add-ons.

## Games & Content Discovery

- [Browse Xbox Game Pass Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/games): Game Pass library browser for console, PC, and mobile gaming discovery.
- [Xbox Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games): Xbox games catalog and digital store with new releases and game listings.
- [Free-to-Play Games on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/free-to-play): Free-to-play games collection for Xbox Series X|S, One, and PC platforms.
- [Optimized for Series X|S](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/optimized): Games optimized for Xbox Series X|S with enhanced load times and 120FPS.
- [Xbox Backward Compatible Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/backward-compatibility): Backward compatible games library from Xbox, 360, and Original Xbox.

## Cross-Platform & Ecosystem

- [Play with Xbox across devices](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/devices): Cross-platform Xbox gaming ecosystem across console, PC, mobile, and VR.
- [Xbox Play Anywhere](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/xbox-play-anywhere): Cross-platform gaming program enabling play on Xbox console and PC.
- [Handheld Compatibility](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/handhelds/handheld-compatibility): Guide for understanding game compatibility on Xbox-supported handheld devices.

## Shopping & Promotions

- [Xbox Official Site: Play Games Anywhere](https://www.xbox.com/en-US): Xbox homepage showcasing gaming across devices with Game Pass and hardware shopping.
- [Xbox Sales and Specials](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/promotions/sales/sales-and-specials): Xbox sales and promotions on consoles, games, subscriptions, and accessories.

## Account & Redemption

- [Redeem Xbox Codes or Gift Cards](https://www.xbox.com/en-us/redeem): How-to guide for redeeming Xbox codes and gift cards for games and Game Pass.
